name: plan
systemPrompt: When the user wants to plan before acting, or break down a task before execution, suggest using Plan Mode.
toast.enter.title: {assistantName} will plan first
toast.enter.desc: I will investigate read-only first, then propose a plan and the points you need to decide. Nothing runs until you confirm.
toast.exit.title: {assistantName} will execute tasks directly
toast.home.enter.desc: Next message will be sent in planning mode and auto-closes after sending.
toast.home.exit.title: {assistantName} will execute tasks directly
confirm.label: Execute
tool.finishPlan.title: Finish plan
tool.finishPlan.description: Call this when the plan is complete and you need the user's approval before acting. It shows a native confirmation in the waiting area: choosing "Execute" means approval and you start executing in this same turn; "Continue Planning" means keep refining. Only valid while Plan Mode is on for this session — do not call it otherwise.
tool.finishPlan.summaryHint: One or two lines saying what will be done next; shown on the confirmation card.
tool.finishPlan.notActive: Plan Mode is not on for this session, so there is no plan to approve. Just answer the user normally.
tool.finishPlan.alreadyAsked: You already asked the user to approve the plan this turn. Wait for their answer instead of asking again.
tool.finishPlan.approved: The user approved the plan and Plan Mode is now off. Carry the plan out in this turn; do not repeat the plan text.
tool.finishPlan.declined: The user chose to keep planning. Do not start executing; if it is unclear what to change, ask them.
tool.finishPlan.noAnswer: The user did not answer ({reason}). Stay in Plan Mode and do not start executing.
execute.prompt: Plan confirmed, please start executing according to the plan above.
